title: Add RecipeStepCombiner
description: Create RecipeStepCombiner.swift with an internal struct exposing a static combine(step: Step, recipe: Recipe) → String method. It iterates each Item in the step: Item.text(s) → appends s verbatim; Item.ingredient(idx) → appends Recipe.ingredients[idx].name; Item.cookware(idx) → appends Recipe.cookware[idx].name; Item.timer(idx) → appends the timer's display string ("<name?> <quantity?>", trimmed). The struct must be at internal access level so CookbookAppTests can reach it.
acceptance_criteria: combine() resolves Item.text to its string value.
A step mixing all four item types produces the expected concatenated string.
RecipeStepCombiner is at internal access level, reachable from the test target.
